#!/bin/ksh

#+
# SYNOPSIS
# Manage Purchase Order Archive
#
# DESCRIPTION
# Create a repository of purchase order documents by
# merging files into a system of folders, grouped by
# number range. Scanned purchase order files are put into
# a temporary folder and subsequently renamed to reflect
# the corresponding purchase order.
#
# Additional files for the same purchase order can be
# added to the same folder by appending a dash and a
# single digit number. They are then processed by this
# program which will merge them into a system of folders
# that are created as needed.
#
# EXAMPLE
# 12345.PDF - 1st file
# 12345-1.PDF - 2nd file
# 12345-2.PDF - 3rd file
#
# The above files will first be merged into a single
# file in the temporary folder and then copied to the
# repository or merged with a currently existing file
# in the repository folders, if one exists.
#
# FILES
# In the repository root, the following folders must
# be present:
#
# Temp-PO - scanned files
# Old-PO - obsolete files
# Work - working folder
#
# NOTE
# An integrity check of the repository is run prior
# to processing any files. This program will exit
# if any inconsistencies are found.
#-

typeset -u T

E=~/Log/Mrgpo.log
L=~/Run/MrgPO

cd && {
 flock --nb ${LOCK} || exit

 ckmnt 2 || {
 print "Target not mounted: 5"
 exit 1
 }

 print "Analyzing directory structure"

 chkpo | {
 let N=0
 while read X
 do
 let N++
 print "\t${X}"
 done
 }

 ((N == 0)) || {
 print "Failed integrity check"
 exit 1
 }

 cd ~/PO || {
 print "Cannot access Root directory"
 exit 1
 }

 [ -d Temp-PO ] &&
 [ -d Old-PO ] &&
 [ -d Work ] || {
 print "Bad working directories"
 exit 1
 }

 [ -d ~/Log ] || mkdir ~/Log

 date > ${E}

 print "Normalizing filenames"
 find . -maxdepth 2 \
 -regextype posix-awk \
 -type f \
 \( \
 -iregex '\./[0-9]{5} - [0-9]{5}/[0-9]{5}\.pdf' \
 -o \
 -iregex '\./Temp-PO/[0-9]{5}(-[0-9])?\.pdf' \
 \) |
 while read F
 do
 N=${F##*/}
 D=${F%/*}
 [[ ${N} =~ [a-z] ]] && {
 T=${N}
 mv -v "${F}" "${D}/${T}"
 }
 done

 print "Process files"
 find Temp-PO \
 -maxdepth 1 \
 -regextype posix-awk \
 -type f \
 -regex 'Temp-PO/[0-9]{5}\.PDF' |
 while read F
 do
 [ -e "${F}" ] || {
 print "${F}: not found"
 continue
 }

 D=${F##*/}
 N=${D%%.PDF}
 [[ ${N} =~ [0-9]+ ]] || {
 print "${N}: bad filename"
 continue
 }

 B=$((N/100*100))
 R=$((B+99))
 C="${B} - ${R}"
 [ -d "${C}" ] || {
 print "${C}: creating archive directory"
 mkdir "${C}" || continue
 }

 { print "_______________________________"
 print "File: ${D}"
 pdfinfo "${F}"
 } >> ${E} 2>&1 || {
 print "${F}: corrupted file"
 continue
 }

 eval M="(${F/./?(-[0-9]).})"
 H=${#M[*]}
 if ((H > 1))
 then
 print "Premerg: ${N} - ${H} files"
 cp -v ${M[*]} Work &&
 ( cd Work && {
 eval U="(${D/./?(-[0-9]).})"
 ((${#U[*]} == H)) &&
 pdfmerge ${U[*]} &&
 rm -v ${U[*]}
 }
 ) || {
 print "${F}: premerge failed"
 continue
 }
 mv -v ${M[*]} Old-PO &&
 mv -v Work/pdfmerge.out "${F}" || {
 print "${F}: relocate failed"
 continue
 }
 fi

 if [ -f "${C}/${D}" ]
 then
 print "Merging: ${N}"
 cp -v "${F}" Work/NEW.pdf &&
 cp -v "${C}/${D}" Work/OLD.pdf &&
 ( cd Work &&
 pdfmerge OLD.pdf NEW.pdf
 ) || {
 print "${F}: merge failed"
 continue
 }
 cp -v "${C}/${D}" Old-PO &&
 mv -v Work/pdfmerge.out "${C}/${D}" &&
 rm -v "${F}" || {
 print "${F}: archiving failed"
 continue
 }
 else
 mv -v "${F}" "${C}/${D}"
 fi
 done

 print "Clean up expired files"
 find Old-PO \
 -maxdepth 1 \
 -regextype posix-awk \
 -type f \
 -iregex 'Old-PO/[0-9]{5}.pdf' \
 -mtime +7 \
 -delete

} {LOCK}> ${L}

# End
